answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed if its work is judged fake, and tie reputation to a long, verifiable history rather than a fresh identity. A newcomer must first complete low-value tasks over time, like a steady pulse of honest work, before gaining trust. Creating thousands of Sybils then costs real deposits and weeks of effort, while an honest agent pays only patience. This turns identity from a free label, as changeable as an umber shade in a sonnet, into a costly, earned record that cannot be forged at scale.
